name: Avaryn
summary:
Avaryn is a Tower Defense MMORPG played in your browser. Quest with friends, and when the enemy marches, build towers and fight beside them.

Pick one of four races, each with a homeland of its own: Humans in the bright vale of Amblevale, the Felis in the Amakar rain forest, Goblins in the Cinderhook Basin and the treefolk Groovians in Rootwake Grove. Then pick a class: Knight, Hunter, Engineer or Druid. Walk one shared continent with other players, hear quest givers speak in their own voices, learn a trade, and hold the line together with your towers when the waves come. It plays on a computer or a phone, with nothing to download.
